name: utm_source
description: Campaign source: names the site, newsletter or ad network that sent you.

name: utm_medium
description: Campaign medium: names the kind of link you clicked, such as email, banner or cpc.

name: utm_campaign
description: Campaign name: names the promotion or campaign the link belongs to.

name: utm_term
description: Campaign term: names the paid search keyword that showed the ad.

name: utm_content
description: Campaign content: tells apart different ads or links within the same campaign.

name: utm_id
description: Campaign ID: identifies the specific campaign or promotion behind the link.

name: fbclid
description: Facebook click ID: lets Facebook connect this visit to the account that clicked.

name: gclid
description: Google Ads click ID: lets Google Ads connect this visit to the ad click.

name: msclkid
description: Microsoft Advertising click ID: lets Microsoft connect this visit to the ad click.

name: yclid
description: Yandex Direct click ID: lets Yandex connect this visit to the ad click.

name: dclid
description: Google display click ID: lets Google's display ad tools connect this visit to the ad click.

name: twclid
description: X Ads click ID: lets X connect this visit to the ad click.

name: cmpid
description: Campaign ID: a common name for the campaign code a site reads into its analytics.

name: s_cid
description: Adobe Analytics campaign code: a common name for the tracking code sites send to Adobe.

name: wt_mc
description: Mapp Intelligence media code: tells Mapp's analytics which campaign sent you.

name: _openstat
description: Openstat tag: tells analytics tools such as Yandex Metrica which ad campaign sent you.

name: mc_cid
description: Mailchimp campaign ID: identifies the Mailchimp email campaign that contained the link.

name: mc_eid
description: Mailchimp email ID: identifies the recipient whose email contained the link.

name: _hsenc
description: HubSpot identity tracking: identifies the contact who clicked a link in a HubSpot email.

name: mkt_tok
description: Marketo tracking token: lets Marketo follow your visit after you click a Marketo email.

name: hsCtaTracking
description: HubSpot CTA tracking: records clicks on a HubSpot call-to-action button.

name: oly_enc_id
description: Omeda encrypted customer ID: lets the publisher's Omeda tracking recognize the reader.

name: vero_id
description: Vero user ID: identifies the email recipient who clicked, so Vero can recognize them.

name: __s
description: Drip subscriber ID: undocumented by Drip; appears to identify the email recipient who clicked.

name: _ga
description: Older Google Analytics linker: carries your Analytics visitor ID to another of the site's domains.

name: _gl
description: Google tag linker: carries your Google measurement cookie IDs to another of the site's domains.

name: srsltid
description: Google Merchant Center result ID: lets the shop connect your visit to a Google listing click.

name: gad_source
description: Google Ads source: identifies where the ad click came from, for Google's conversion measurement.

name: ref
description: Referral tag: names the site, page or partner that sent you; each site picks its own values.

name: igsh
description: Instagram share ID: undocumented; appears to identify the share that produced the link.

name: igshid
description: Instagram share ID, older name: undocumented; appears to identify the share behind the link.

name: si
description: YouTube share ID: undocumented; appears to identify the share that produced the link.

name: si
description: Spotify share ID: undocumented; appears to link listening back to the share it came from.

name: feature
description: YouTube link origin: undocumented; appears to record where the link came from, e.g. share.

name: pp
description: YouTube page context: undocumented; YouTube adds it to video links on feeds and channel pages.

name: ref_src
description: Twitter referral source: undocumented; appears to record which page or search sent you.

name: ref_src
description: X referral source: undocumented; appears to record which page or search sent you.

name: s
description: Twitter share source: undocumented; appears to record the app a post was shared from.

name: s
description: X share source: undocumented; appears to record the app a post was shared from.

name: t
description: Twitter share token: undocumented; added to copied post links and appears tied to the sharer.

name: t
description: X share token: undocumented; added to copied post links and appears tied to the sharer.

name: mibextid
description: Facebook share tag: undocumented; appears on Facebook links shared outside Facebook.

name: __tn__
description: Facebook navigation tag: undocumented; appears on links inside Facebook, purpose not public.

name: trk
description: LinkedIn tracking tag: undocumented; appears to name the LinkedIn page element you clicked.

name: share_id
description: Reddit share ID: undocumented; appears to identify the share that produced the link.

name: ved
description: Google result click data: undocumented; appears to record which result element you clicked.

name: ei
description: Google search ID: undocumented; appears to identify the search and when it started.

name: oq
description: Google typed query: undocumented; appears to hold what you typed before picking a suggestion.

name: gs_lcrp
description: Chrome search box data: undocumented; Chrome adds it when you search from the address bar.

name: sca_esv
description: Google search token: undocumented; Google adds it to results links, purpose not public.

name: cvid
description: Bing search ID: undocumented; appears to identify a search session on Bing.

name: tag
description: Amazon Associates tracking ID: credits the affiliate who shared the link for purchases.

name: qid
description: Amazon search timestamp: undocumented; appears to record when the search that led here ran.

name: sr
description: Amazon result position: undocumented; appears to record where the item was in search results.

name: crid
description: Amazon search reference: undocumented; appears on links clicked from Amazon search results.

name: pd_rd_*
description: Amazon recommendation data: undocumented; appears on links from product recommendation rows.

name: pf_rd_*
description: Amazon page placement data: undocumented; appears on links from product carousels.

name: linkCode
description: Amazon link code: undocumented; appears on Associates links next to the affiliate tag.

name: ascsubtag
description: Amazon Associates sub-tag: undocumented by Amazon; affiliate tools call it a per-click SubID.

name: otracker
description: Flipkart click tracker: undocumented; appears to name the page section you clicked from.

name: lid
description: Flipkart listing ID: undocumented; appears to identify the seller listing you clicked.

name: srno
description: Flipkart result position: undocumented; appears to record where the item was in a list.

name: spm
description: Alibaba traffic tag: tells Alibaba-run sites where the visitor came from.

name: smid
description: New York Times share tag: undocumented; appears to record how the article was shared.
